correctness.rationale: The source gives the exact binary generator polynomial. Its six degree-\(<15\) shifts have rank \(6\), and exact enumeration of all \(64\) messages gives minimum weight \(6\), matching the source parameter. Because the generator map is an isomorphism, every code subcode is represented by exactly one message subspace. Unique reduced-row-echelon enumeration gives \(63,651,1395,651,63,1\) subspaces in dimensions \(1,\ldots,6\). For each basis, the union of basis-word supports is exactly the support of the generated subcode. The complete \(2824\)-subspace census therefore proves every support multiplicity and generalized-weight minimum in the claim.
